questions.q: All those old buildings ____ down tomorrow.
questions.zh: 這些舊建築物明天都將被拆除。
questions.explain: will/shall be + p.p. ➜ 未來簡單式被動語態。

questions.q: Last summer my classmate was ____ Beijing Railway Administration.
questions.zh: 去年暑假，我同學受雇於鐵路局。
questions.explain: 人 + be employed by ...（受雇於…，用過去簡單式被動語態）。

questions.q: At present a new road ____ in that part of the city.
questions.zh: 目前在市內那個地區有條新路正在修築中。
questions.explain:
① At present（目前），與現在進行式連用。
② 道路是被修築的，應用現在進行式被動語態 is being built。

questions.q: Only 50 new students ____ into the department in 1965.
questions.zh: 在 1965 年，只有五十位新生獲准進入該系。
questions.explain: 學生被准許入學，且有明確過去時間 in 1965，用過去簡單式被動語態 were admitted。

questions.q: Computers are ____ in space travel.
questions.zh: 電腦現今被用於太空航行中。
questions.explain: be + being + p.p. ➜ 表示進行式的被動。

questions.q: The price of the commodities ____ the cost price.
questions.zh: 商品的價格已被打折到成本價格了。
questions.explain:
① 價格「已被降至」（has been reduced to）。
② 主詞「價格」（price）為單數，故助動詞用 has。

questions.q: When you return next winter, the house ____.
questions.zh: 當你明年冬天回來時，房子就完工了。
questions.explain:
① When + S + 現在簡單式（表示未來時間），主要子句表示到那時已完成，用「未來完成式」。
② the house（房子）是被建造完成，需用被動語態 will have been finished。

questions.q: A big fire ____ in our neighborhood last night.
questions.zh: 昨晚在我們家附近發生了一場火災。
questions.explain: break out（爆發、發生）為不及物動詞片語，不可用被動語態。

questions.q: Nobody knows when the accident ____.
questions.zh: 沒有人知道意外事件在何時發生。
questions.explain: happen（= take place，發生）為不及物動詞，不可用被動語態；事情已發生，故用過去簡單式 happened。

questions.q: More crimes ____ in summer than at any other time.
questions.zh: 在夏天比在其他時候有更多的犯罪案件發生。
questions.explain: take place（= happen，發生）為不及物動詞片語，不可用被動語態；主詞 crimes 為複數，用原形動詞 take place。

questions.q: His teacher seemed to ____ his composition.
questions.zh: 他老師對他的作文似乎感到滿意。
questions.explain: be satisfied with（對……感到滿意），seem to 後接原形動詞 be satisfied with。

questions.q: Many young people ____ such outdoor activities as jogging, hiking, and so on.
questions.zh: 許多年輕人喜歡慢跑、健行等戶外活動。
questions.explain: take interest in = be interested in（對……感興趣）。

questions.q: Animals can do many amazing things when they are ____.
questions.zh: 動物經過適當訓練後，會做許多令人驚異的事。
questions.explain:
① are properly trained（被適當訓練）。
② train 作動詞意為「訓練；養成」。

questions.q: So far as I am concerned, I don't like ____ in that way.
questions.zh: 就我而言，我不喜歡被那樣對待。
questions.explain:
① So far as + S + be concerned（就……而言）。
② treat + 人（待人）／人 + be treated（被人對待），like 後接不定詞被動式 to be treated。

questions.q: He was ____ all of his best friends.
questions.zh: 他被他所有最好的朋友嘲笑。
questions.explain: laugh at + 人（嘲笑某人）➜ 人 + be laughed at by...（某人被…嘲笑），介系詞 at 不可省略。

questions.q: I ____ that this news is quite true.
questions.zh: 我相信這消息是真的。
questions.explain: be convinced that + S + V ／ of + N（深信、相信……）。

questions.q: We are taught ____ our enemies.
questions.zh: 我們被教導原諒我們的敵人。
questions.explain: teach + 人 + to + V（教導某人做……）= 人 + be taught to + V（某人被教導做……）。

questions.q: They say the examination ____ over again.
questions.zh: 他們說考試必須再度舉行。
questions.explain: 考試是被舉行／應試，用被動語態 has to be taken。

questions.q: The fusion torch might save mankind from ____ in its own trash.
questions.zh: 核融合噴火器可能使人類免於被自己的垃圾所埋葬。
questions.explain:
① save... from + V-ing（解救……免於……）。
② save... from + being + p.p.（解救……免於被……）。
③ be buried 表示「被埋葬」，因在介系詞 from 之後，故以動名詞形式 being buried 表示。

questions.q: Air conditioners ____ in the summer months.
questions.zh: 冷氣機在夏季銷路很好。
questions.explain:
① 東西賣得好（或差），習慣上用主動方式表達，如 sell well（銷路好）。
② 東西被買時，應用被動語態 be bought (by people)。

questions.q: We had dinner at the new restaurant the other night; the food was good and we were well ____.
questions.zh: 前幾天晚上我們在這家新餐廳吃晚餐，菜不錯而且我們享受到很好的服務。
questions.explain: take care of 人（照顧某人）➜ be taken care of（受照顧、享受服務）。

questions.q: After she ____ told the news, she ran home to tell her mother.
questions.zh: 人家告訴她這消息後，她就跑回家告訴她母親。
questions.explain:
① tell + 人 + 事（告訴某人某事）➜ 人 + be told + 事（某人被告知某事）。
② be told 發生在 ran home 之前，所以用過去完成式 had been told。

questions.q: Once clay ____, it can be converted by firing into a hard and enduring material.
questions.zh: 一旦黏土已塑好形狀，它能被火燒成一種堅硬而耐久的東西。
questions.explain: clay（黏土）是被塑好形狀，故用被動式 has been shaped。

questions.q: To keep the road as pleasant as possible, most of these trees ____ when the road is widened.
questions.zh: 為使這條路盡可能地保持令人愉快的感覺，當道路拓寬時，大部分的樹應被保留。
questions.explain: tree（樹）要被保留，故用被動式 should be preserved。

questions.q: These machines ought ____ once a year.
questions.zh: 這些機器每年必須檢查一次。
questions.explain:
① should = ought to + V（應該、必須）。
② be inspected（被檢查）。

questions.q: We found the house deserted. The furniture ____ all piled up and the chairs were covered.
questions.zh: 我們發現這房子沒人住。家具都堆了起來，椅子也罩起來了。
questions.explain: 物 + be piled up（東西被堆起來）；furniture（家具）為不可數名詞，動詞用單數 was。

questions.q: Nobody is quite sure what she does with the money, but it ____ that she sends it to relatives in a foreign country.
questions.zh: 沒有人能十分確信她如何處理這筆錢，但人們相信，她將錢寄給在國外的親戚們。
questions.explain: It is believed that + 子句（大家相信……）。

questions.q:
下列選項填入空格何者錯誤？
We were met at the station ____.
questions.zh: 我們在車站受到迎接……。
questions.explain: 本題為挑錯題。(C) 介系詞錯誤，應改成 by a brass band（由管樂隊迎接）。(A)、(B)、(D) 皆合乎語法。

questions.q:
下列選項何者不可填入空格？
I hate being ____ indoors on a hot summer day.
questions.zh: 我討厭在炎炎夏日中被留在室內。
questions.explain:
① keep / confine / tell 是及物動詞，可用被動形式。
② remain 是不及物動詞，沒有被動形式，故不可用 being remained。

questions.q: Mother was so glad to see me after all these years that soon I was ____ tightly in her arms.
questions.zh: 母親很高興在那麼多年後看到我，所以她立即將我擁入懷中。
questions.explain:
本題 (D) held 與 (E) being held 皆合適。
(A) was hold 出現兩個動詞原形，不合語法。
(B) was holding 為過去進行式主動語態，不合題意。
(C) was to be holding 表示主動，不合題意。
(D) held（被擁入懷中）；(E) being held（正被擁入懷中）。

sections.title: （三）翻譯填充題
sections.instructions: 依中文提示在空格中填入適當的字詞

questions.q:
綁架幼童應處死刑。
Those who kidnap the child should ____ s____ to death.
questions.zh: 綁架幼童應處死刑。
questions.explain:
① sentence ['sɛntəns] 動詞：宣判；判決
② kidnap ['kɪdnæp] 動詞：誘拐（兒童）；綁架

questions.q:
軍人很受國人的尊敬。
Soldiers ____ h____ r____ by their countrymen.
questions.zh: 軍人很受國人的尊敬。
questions.explain:
① highly 副詞：很；極
② speak highly of（十分讚揚），think highly of（敬重；重視）

questions.q:
關於這件意外，我不便表示任何意見。
R____ this accident, I ____ not s____ to make any comment.
questions.zh: 關於這件意外，我不便表示任何意見。
questions.explain:
① regarding 介系詞 = with reference to = concerning（關於）
② be supposed to + V（被期望；應該）

questions.q:
你最好把那顆壞牙拔掉。
You had ____ have that bad tooth ____ ____.
questions.zh: 你最好把那顆壞牙拔掉。
questions.explain:
① had better = may as well + V（最好）
② have/make + 受詞 + 受詞補語 (p.p.)：（使…被…）如：have hair cut（理髮）

questions.q:
你完全了解此事的真相嗎？
____ you fully ____ with the truth of the whole business?
questions.zh: 你完全了解此事的真相嗎？
questions.explain: be acquainted with = be familiar with（熟悉；了解…）

sections.title: （四）連貫式翻譯
sections.instructions: 將下列中文句子翻譯成英文

questions.q: 垃圾是造成環境污染的一個重要因素。
answer: Garbage is one of the important factors that contribute to environmental pollution.
Garbage is one of the important factors that cause environmental pollution.
questions.zh: 垃圾是造成環境污染的一個重要因素。
questions.explain: contribute to / cause 意為「促成；導致」。

questions.q: 在台灣，一天所產生出來的垃圾相當多。
answer: In Taiwan, the amount of garbage created in a day is quite large.
In Taiwan, the amount of garbage produced in a day is quite large.
In Taiwan, the amount of garbage created in a day is a lot.
In Taiwan, the amount of garbage produced in a day is a lot.
questions.zh: 在台灣，一天所產生出來的垃圾相當多。
questions.explain: created / produced 為過去分詞作形容詞修飾 garbage。

questions.q: 垃圾帶來蚊蠅，使疾病快速傳染。
answer: Garbage brings flies and mosquitoes, which cause diseases to spread rapidly.
Garbage brings flies and mosquitoes, which cause epidemics to spread rapidly.
questions.zh: 垃圾帶來蚊蠅，使疾病快速傳染。
questions.explain: which 引導非限定關係子句修飾前面的整件事或蚊蠅；cause + O + to V 表示「使…做…」。

questions.q: 而且，這些垃圾常使得河川無法淨化。
answer: Besides, garbage often makes it impossible for rivers to be purified.
Besides, garbage often keeps rivers from being purified.
questions.zh: 而且，這些垃圾常使得河川無法淨化。
questions.explain: keep... from + V-ing 表示「使…無法…」；purify 用被動式 being purified。

questions.q: 因此，保護河川不致受污染是人人之責。
answer: Therefore, it's everybody's business to keep rivers from being polluted by garbage.
Therefore, it's everybody's business to preserve rivers from being polluted by garbage.
questions.zh: 因此，保護河川不致受污染是人人之責。
questions.explain: preserve / keep rivers from being polluted 表示「保護河川免於受到污染」。

sections.title: （五）選答案測驗
sections.instructions: 閱讀下列短文，選出最適當的答案填入各題空格中
sections.passage:
One way to have good health 1. ____ healthful foods. Your body uses healthful foods to grow new cells. These foods are also 2. ____ to repair damaged cells. Your body uses healthful foods to keep cells, tissues, organs, and organ systems 3. ____. They provide the energy your body 4. ____. When you eat healthful foods and exercise, your weight may 5. ____.
Healthful foods have different nutrients. A nutrient is a substance 6. ____ living things for growth. When you eat, the food 7. ____ by the digestive system. Nutrients from the food move into your bloodstream. They 8. ____ to cells throughout your body. The nutrients 9. ____ by the cells to keep your body healthy. The cells divide as they grow. More cells 10. ____ and your body grows.
vocabulary_notes: 7. digestive [dɪ'dʒɛstɪv / də'dʒɛstɪv] 形容詞：消化的

questions.q: One way to have good health ____ healthful foods.
questions.zh: 擁有健康的一種方法是吃有益健康的食物。
questions.explain: One way (to have...) S (不定詞作形容詞修飾語) is V (to eat...) 不定詞作主詞補語 (SC)。

questions.q: These foods are also ____ to repair damaged cells.
questions.zh: 這些食物也是修復受損細胞所需要的。
questions.explain: These foods are also needed (to repair...)（被需要）不定詞作副詞修飾語。

questions.q: Your body uses healthful foods to keep cells, tissues, organs, and organ systems ____.
questions.zh: 你的身體利用有益健康的食物來保持細胞、組織、器官和器官系統正常運作。
questions.explain: ...keep + O + working（保持…運轉）。

questions.q: They provide the energy your body ____.
questions.zh: 它們提供你身體所需的能量。
questions.explain: ...the energy [(which) your body needs].（關係子句）S1 V1。

questions.q: When you eat healthful foods and exercise, your weight may ____.
questions.zh: 當你吃有益健康的食物並運動時，你的體重就可以受到控制。
questions.explain: 「體重被控制」，助動詞 may 後面接原形被動式 be controlled。

questions.q: A nutrient is a substance ____ living things for growth.
questions.zh: 營養素是生物生長所需要的物質。
questions.explain: ...substance [(which is) needed by...] 關係子句簡化為被動分詞片語。

questions.q: When you eat, the food ____ by the digestive system.
questions.zh: 當你吃東西時，食物被消化系統轉化。
questions.explain:
① ...the food (S) is changed (V) (by the...)（副詞片語）。
②「食物被改變／消化」，應用現在簡單式被動語態 is changed。

questions.q: They ____ to cells throughout your body.
questions.zh: 它們被輸送到你全身的細胞。
questions.explain:
① 主詞 They = Nutrients（營養素）。
② They are carried (to cells) (throughout...)
S V 副詞片語 副詞片語；「營養素被運送」，故用 are carried。

questions.q: The nutrients ____ by the cells to keep your body healthy.
questions.zh: 營養素被細胞利用以維持你身體的健康。
questions.explain:
①「營養素被使用」，應用被動語態 are used。
② The nutrients (S) are used (V) (by...)（副詞片語）(to keep...)（副詞片語）。

questions.q: More cells ____ and your body grows.
questions.zh: 更多的細胞被製造出來，你的身體便成長了。
questions.explain:
More cells (S) are produced (V) and...
（更多的細胞被製造…），用現在簡單式被動語態 are produced。
